thread:
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for service-frontend (r-452) in us-east-1 -> 5% traffic. healthcheck: /health. monitoring: https://obs/redwood/r-452

sam: seeing an uptick in 5xx from the canary group, starting ~2m ago. dashboards show 5xx rate ~3.4% on canary nodes.
jordan: confirming. probe failures on /health returning 503s, latency also up. full probe logs attached to the dashboard.
maya: abort criteria in play: configured auto-abort if 5xx > 2% for 5m. We're at 3.4% for ~3m, engineer decision needed to flip kill-switch or let auto-abort run.
sam: we shouldn't risk customer impact. prepping to flip kill switch. paging @on-call for visibility.
pagerduty: Pager duty alert triggered: PD#3892 - canary-5xx-spike (sev3) -> notified sam.
jordan: quick root-cause clues: KV cache timeouts on a subset of inference pods, see log sample: ```
2026-03-12T22:10:34Z frontend-7f9d: ERROR kvcache: timeout reading shard-3: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-12T22:10:34Z frontend-7f9d: WARN handler: upstream returned 503 for /health (backend timeout)
```
sam: executing kill-switch: setting feature flag `rollout.canary_enabled` -> `false` (via internal flag service). Command: `flagctl set rollout.canary_enabled false --env prod --id r-452`
deploy-bot: acknowledged. flag change applied, shifting canary weight to 0%. traffic rebalanced.
maya: also disabling new canary instances and triggering gradual rollback job `rollback r-452` (not forceful full rollback yet).
jordan: monitoring: 5xx rate on canary group dropping, overall 5xx for frontend cluster returning to baseline within 30s.
sam: customer impact assessment: looking at recent error report stream - 0.6% of total requests saw 5xx during the window, ~12 distinct customer IDs reported errors in the 10m window. No evidence of data loss. Created ticket CS-1147 to notify affected accounts.
maya: mitigation notes: cause likely related to a quantized model path that exercised a new kernel; some inference pods hit a backend timeout which bubbled up as 503. We'll quarantine the build and block model variant until root-cause confirmed.
jordan: ops checklist:
- kill-switch flipped (confirmed)
- rollback job started (in progress)
- autoscaler unaffected
- tracing samples collected (span IDs attached)

sam: leaving a short incident handoff for night shift (@taylor): please watch for any replayed 5xx or re-roll attempts. Follow-up items: postmortem, block variant in model-catalog, canary tuning (lower initial weight + longer observation).
pagerduty: incident leaflet: SEV3 -> reduced after mitigation. PD note added: "Canary 5xx spike; feature-flag abort executed; rollback started; limited customer errors; follow-up required."
maya: assigning follow-ups to eng-ml and eng-runtime, will create tasks and attach logs.
sam: thanks all. closing thread here, will update the incident in #incidents if anything reoccurs. :white_check_mark:
